title: Organic Pesticides Safer?
summary: Scientist rebuts the idea that organic-approved pesticides are inherently safer and says residues on all produce are far below limits.

assertions.quote: it's a common misconception that organic doesn't use pesticides
what is not true is that pesticides approved for organic farming are inherently safer than conventional pesticides
regularly detects them at levels hundreds to thousands of times below their tolerance levels
please don't let people scare you away from eating fruits and vegetables because of pesticides
